2014_spells.otherworldly-form.descriptio: You draw on the magic of the Lower Planes or the Upper Planes (your choice) to transform yourself, gaining the following benefits for the duration: • Your eyes become pools of darkness, and you gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet. • You gain a fly speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. • You gain resistance to either fire or necrotic damage (your choice). • Your weapons are imbued with otherworldly energy. When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d6 force damage. • You gain a +1 bonus to your spell save DC.
2014_spells.otherworldly-form.effectSumm: Deal 1d6 force damage to a target within Self
2014_spells.otherworldly-form.fullDescri: Using 1 action, you draw on the magic of the Lower Planes or the Upper Planes (your choice) to transform yourself, gaining the following benefits for the duration: • Your eyes become pools of darkness, and you gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet. When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d6 force damage; • You gain a fly speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. The effect lasts for up to 1 minute; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
